parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the four rotation lids of the box made of cardboard, forming the top flaps that can open or close.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a cover to protect the contents of the box and can be folded inward or outward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the top edge of the box base, allowing opening and closing motion.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the box made of cardboard, similar to the other flaps.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in sealing the box when folded inward and provides structural stability when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line at the top edge of the box.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the third rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard, forming part of the top closure system.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to closing the box and protecting the contents from dust or damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its fold line, allowing it to open or close with the other flaps.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the fourth rotation lid of the box, made of cardboard, completing the set of top flaps.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in fully closing the box and maintaining its shape when sealed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line, moving in coordination with the other lids.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main base body of the box made of cardboard, forming the container’s structure.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the contents of the box, providing the main volume and rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides the foundation for the rotation lids to attach and move.
